verdict.rationale: Whether a vendor uses customer data to train its models is a fair privacy question for an AI and robotics platform that includes models (GR00T) and NVIDIA-hosted resources, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack contains no data-usage policy, training opt-out, or privacy control. Local, Docker, or headless deployment is an adjacent deployment option, not a documented guarantee or setting that keeps user data out of training, so it earns no credit.
